query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c
               JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
               WHERE n.nspname = 'engagement'
                 AND c.relname = format('email_messages_%s',
                     to_char(date_trunc('month', now()) + make_interval(months => $1::int),
                             'YYYYMM'))
           ) AS "existe!"
